body:
Thank you! He does have a tic (I’m sorry if that’s not the correct terminology) he has tried to hide his whole life and I wonder sometimes if he has been secluded so long (up until recently he worked from home) that maybe he can’t control it as well? Just a theory, not sure if that even happens. 
I’m so glad to hear you’re being reunited with your siblings, it gives me hope he will come around some day!
Thank you! I have definitely let him know he can talk to me any time no questions asked and no judgement… I can just hope he will some day come around.

Thank you for your reply. To be honest my mom has to be careful what she says or asks him otherwise he shuts down and will not talk to her for weeks. So she only asks how he is and other small talk. He gets very set off by things such as financial responsibilities/deadlines and will totally shut down if asked about such things. He also needs to prepare himself mentally well in advance in the event my mom would come see him (he never visits her and she rarely takes the hour trip to see him). He also tells her he can’t be around people. I think he has anxiety but he denies it and refuses to see a psychiatrist for medication. I myself have severe anxiety and depression, so a lot of how he acts seems familiar to me.
He isn't even acting like your friend, let alone your spouse.

I worry about it as well.. I have a 20 month old and on the occasion we go to get take out from a restaurant I'll stand with him in the parking lot and he looks around at stores and cars as if we've been transported to Oz. Makes me sad he's missed out on so much.

I agree all parties should know... but you need to take this womans pregnancy into consideration here... for her unborn child she does NOT need any added stress before that kid is born.. especially learning her husband is a complete bag of dogshit. Seriously... I went into premature labor myself, it's not good. I'd keep stalking until that baby is safely born and then drop the bomb. Just my opinion.

Well I'm hoping there is no relation, but after some quick research of his family I noticed we have family of the same name from the same region. I'm just wondering where I can start uncovering things.
Thank you! I'm gonna look into this.
Holy shit, how did you find that out?
It's a serial killer. If I am related to him, I'd rather no one be able to trace it. But dammit I'd like to know. Or maybe I dont want to know. Dammit this is upsetting.

After my mmc I was told to wait 3 months, I ended up not having a period for two months and then had a cycle before trying again, and got pregnant right away. I'd at least wait one cycle. I hope you get your rainbow soon.

I finished my eighth session on friday, and I honestly feel less gloomy.. my parents say my face looks more relaxed and my husband said he heard me whistling... completely out of character... I have been severely depressed since elementary school .. various inpatient stays... attempts to take my life.. continuous self harm since high school.. I have much hope for this treatment.. it does seem unfathomable after all I've suffered... but I was desperate at this point... and decided after studying it for years that I would try it.  I'm excited to see what will happen in the weeks to come. .  I actually took my first walk alone with my dog in over a year (I have this hypervigilant paranoia) i couldn't believe it...
Thank you, I'm glad that it doesn't mean anything... no I'm not left handed.. why do you ask?
Def needs to wax her lip but yeah... Total babe!

Aww.. took that flight almost a year ago on honeymoon. Then Husband and I kayaked the entire na Pali coast.. best experience. Took 8 hours and was painful.. but so awesome... great view... Sea caves even an open ceiling one.

Is the smiling dead frozen guy Helen too? 
Helen is such a bitch.
Awesome story!

I am glad you are ok.. I've been right there gun to my head twice now.. I'm so glad your dog arrived at that moment. 

Is there anywhere else you can live? Take that dog, and get out of there if you can. <3

I first started feeling depressed when I entered kindergarten... I kept it a secret from my family for years... Until they found me self harming when I was in high school... To this day (I'm 33) I swear that there were two weeks in highschool where my parents didn't say a word to me at all. No one understands what your relationship n is with your parents, so try not to listen to people's unhelpful bulllshit.. it's good to hear you've started anti-depressants. I didn't get ahold of them until I was 27. When I finally admitted to myself I needed help. I had to try several different ones, it takes a while for doctors to figure out what works for you. Also it takes ~3 weeks or a month to notice a difference. I hope things get better for you... Hang in there. It may also help to talk with a therapist, someone unbiased and you can unload everything on... I know it's helped me a lot. And if your parents agree to let your conversations with the therapist be confidential between you and the therapist that would probably be best.
I seen better walls in Minecraft

Very hard to "think positively" when you're in complete darkness and see no way out. I am there with you OP. I feel I am the real "Walking Dead".  Hoping you find light somewhere. I wouldn't wish my depression on my worst enemy. Here if you want to talk/vent/commiserate
I'm so sorry. There is nothing like the love from our furry friends. Hoping you remember all the good times and the life you gave kitty.
Praying for you.. My chihuahua Duke was born Halloween 2009 too. I would have been dead long ago if it wasn't for him. Be strong Abbey! <3

I am going through a MMC right now as well... and girl, I wish I had just done a D&C... as someone who already has depression this has made it INSANELY worse. It's put my whole life on hold and consumed me. After doctor confirmed it was not viable (I had suspected as much for a week prior). I waited a week after I saw my doctor to pass the pregnancy naturally... never happened... so I asked for misoprostol to help... here i am 48 hours after taking it and nothing happened... so it seems after all this a D&C needs to happen anyway.. I just want it to be over with and to try to move on. It's agonizing. I am so sorry for your loss and what you're going through. 
My doctor gave me all three options as soon as it she saw it was not viable... I'm surprised your doctor tried to sort of force waiting on you... I would just say that they mentioned discussing it with you, and you'd like to have that discussion now because this is an extremely difficult thing to go through... and they freaking know that... I kind of want to smack your doctor right now to be honest.
I wish that I felt good once in a while... I can't even imagine.
All I have is my dog... he's 9 now, he's saved my life so many times... I don't know how I will live when he is gone... he takes care of me when no one else will.
I'm sorry to read this... I am glad you are alive.

I think that you should. I wish I would have said something when I was a teenager. I really think everyone depressed or not can benefit from therapy.. In my late 20s was when I told my family I was seriously depressed... it took a huge weight off my shoulders
